description: This file defines functions for transforming PyTorch FX graph modules by replacing set_grad_enabled nodes with hop-based subgraphs, including splitting and inlining subgraphs, as part of a graph rewriting pass.

methods.name: _is_set_grad_enabled_node
methods.description: Checks if a node is a call to torch._C._set_grad_enabled.

methods.name: _is_set_grad_enabled_sub_mod
methods.description: Determines if a node is a submodule with a set_grad_enabled call, optionally omitting if it matches the ambient setting.

methods.name: _replace_with_hop
methods.description: Replaces a module node with a hop-based subgraph if it contains set_grad_enabled nodes.

methods.name: _remove_set_grad_and_inline
methods.description: Removes set_grad_enabled nodes from a subgraph and inlines the parent node.

methods.name: _sequential_split_and_maybe_inline_subgraphs
methods.description: Splits a graph module into subgraphs based on set_grad_enabled nodes and inlines or replaces them with hop subgraphs.

methods.name: replace_set_grad_with_hop_pass
methods.description: Main function that applies the transformation pass to a graph module, splitting and inlining subgraphs based on set_grad_enabled nodes.
